product_launches.description: Stoic and publisher Xbox Game Studios will officially launch the side-scrolling action RPG Towerborne as a paid, offline-capable game on February 26, changing from its originally planned free-to-play, always-online model.

product_launches.description: The update introduces a group finder, new map areas, a higher level cap, legendary weapons, and more.

overview_description.description: Stoic was founded by Arnie Jorgensen, John Watson, and Alex Thomas in early 2012. They left BioWare in 2012 after finishing the production of Star Wars: The Old Republic and wanted to make their “dream game”, which would then become The Banner Saga. Using crowdfunding platform Kickstarter, Stoic successfully funded the team within 2 days though the team initially wanted to fund the game using their own personal savings. The funds raised far exceeded their expectations, thus the team expanded the game’s scope to include more features.

product.name: The Banner Saga
product.description: A story-driven tactical role-playing game set in a Viking-inspired world, combining turn-based combat, caravan management, and choices that affect the narrative.

product.name: Towerborne
product.description: A cooperative action role-playing game developed by Stoic in partnership with Xbox Game Studios.

product.name: Banner Saga 2
product.description: A tactical role-playing sequel featuring turn-based combat, branching decisions, caravan travel, and story continuity from The Banner Saga.

product.name: Banner Saga 3
product.description: The concluding tactical role-playing game in the Banner Saga series, with party management, turn-based combat, and choices that lead to different endings.
